description: You are a science curriculum developer at the Education Innovation Institute evaluating GCompris's science and experiment activities for alignment with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS). GCompris educational software is open on the screen. Your task is to: (1) Navigate to the Science section of GCompris and explore the Experiment sub-tab, systematically opening and interacting with AT LEAST THREE different science experiment activities — including activities about physics (e.g., Gravity, Watercycle), color/optics (e.g., Mixing paint colors, Mixing light colors), and any others you find. (2) For each experiment activity you open, note the scientific concept it demonstrates, the grade level it appears designed for, and whether it correctly models the underlying science. (3) Write a NGSS Curriculum Alignment Report to ~/Desktop/science_curriculum_report.txt. The report must list each experiment activity you evaluated, identify the scientific concept(s) demonstrated (e.g., fluid dynamics, color theory, light physics), suggest an appropriate grade band (K-2, 3-5, 6-8), and include an overall recommendation for whether GCompris's science activities are suitable for classroom supplemental instruction.
